label: Canopy height, median
description: 50th percentile of plant-point height above the soil plane

label: Canopy height, p75
description: 75th percentile of plant-point height above the soil plane

label: Canopy height, p95
description: 95th percentile of plant-point height above the soil plane

label: Projected leaf area
description: top-view area of the plant points (ground area per pixel)

label: Leaf area (tilt-corrected)
description: projected area divided by cos(leaf inclination), capped 75°

label: Canopy volume
description: convex hull of plant points and their projection on the soil plane

label: Canopy radius
description: 95th percentile of horizontal distance from the plant centre

label: Leaf inclination, mean
description: mean angle between surface normals and the soil normal (0° flat); rises in both beds from 09-03

label: Leaf inclination, spread
description: SD of leaf inclination; below the noise floor (E1)

label: Droop index
description: height_p50 / height_p95; falls when leaf tips sink

label: Compactness
description: projected area / area of the 2D convex hull in top view

label: Plant point count
description: ToF points on the isolated plant (scales with visible leaf area)

label: Cylinder height, median
description: height_p50 of all vegetation in the plant cylinder

label: Cylinder height, p75
description: height_p75 of all vegetation in the plant cylinder

label: Cylinder height, p95
description: height_p95 of all vegetation in the plant cylinder

label: Cylinder projected area
description: projected area of all vegetation in the plant cylinder

label: Cylinder point count
description: vegetation points in the plant cylinder

label: Sensor to soil distance
description: depth of the fitted soil plane below the camera

label: Overlap fraction
description: share of plant points at the 8.5 cm cylinder wall

label: Plant off-centre distance
description: isolated plant centroid to expected centre

label: RGB brightness
description: mean RGB brightness of the frames used (dark below 10)
